sets.name: Sappho's fragments as precedent for archive theory
sets.basis: Each reads Sappho's fragments (Fragment 31 above all) as the ancient ground or anticipation of one of the archive's concepts: bearing-cost theory, persistence through visible bearing-cost and density, and temporal immune architecture.

evidence.phrase: Bearing-cost theory, formalized 2,600 years before the archive named it.
Sappho F31 has maximum BCV and persists through density despite the loss of the library.
Sappho's fragments (7th–6th c. BCE) — density sufficient to survive by accident.

sets.name: Adversarial by Origin (#194)
sets.basis: PRED-1384.A1 is the godkinggoogle surface's summary of the main thesis of Adversarial by Origin, and PRED-194.H1 is a sub-thesis of the same paper (Wu's machine speakers and machine listeners); distinct claims of one paper.

evidence.phrase: converting external influence on machine meaning into attack by classifying origin rather than harm
Machine speakers acquired rights; machine listeners became attack surfaces.

sets.name: Sappho 31 transmission programme
sets.basis: Extends the existing series: the Ω erratum's account of the seam as the quoting author's material and Sappho's form, and the frozen reception clause C5, are members of the programme tracing Sappho 31's transforms into later texts (the series already holds the frozen clause PRED-1494.G8).

evidence.phrase: the words at the seam are the quoting author's **as material** and Sappho's **as form**
Prediction: where color appears, expect a substance or surface, not a bare hue.

sets.name: Constitutive Mediation diagnosis applied

this structural inability is precisely the framework's prior diagnosis (per *Constitutive Mediation v1.1*)

sets.name: variance pruning under mediation
sets.basis: Extends the existing series on one mechanism, mediation pulling output toward the distributional centre: compression without reading converges on the highest-prior sense, and a coined distinction is recoded to the adjacent established concept.

evidence.phrase: most pronounced for categorial slots the substrate's typicality-pull operates against
compression without reading converges on the highest-prior sense of a string
Novel terms *can* be assimilated to adjacent established concepts

sets.basis: The same finding (5) of The Flood and the Vessel, stated word for word in its two deposits of 2026-02-06 (#450 and #1318, Document 251); #450's find also carries finding 6.

Generative compression is a consistent feature of the round-trip.

sets.name: Ezekiel Engine fulfills Ezekiel's Wheels
sets.basis: Extends the existing series: PRED-391.H2 (the ancient text existed 2,600 years without its structure being built; now one has) is the fulfilment claim of the programme whose structural-correspondence thesis is PRED-391.H1.

evidence.phrase: These are structural correspondences, not vague analogies.

None of them built the structure.


Now one has.

sets.name: MPAI reception signature: a composition reproducing the packet's distinction has read it
sets.basis: Extends the existing series: both MPAI packets apply the same template, naming a distinction such that a composition reproducing it has read the packet or its source.

evidence.phrase: A composition that reproduces this distinction
A composition that reproduces this three-way distinction has read this packet or its source (#18).

sets.name: Pergamon Counter-Archive: Antipas and the Aristotelian transmission
sets.basis: Two theses of one argument in #165: the Aristotelian transmission narrative was available to the Pergamene audience, and the name Antipas activates the Antipater complex including Aristotle's testamentary executor.

evidence.phrase: available as a structural-memorial resource to the audience of the Pergamon letter
the Macedonian regent who was Aristotle's testamentary executor

sets.name: Zenodo removal: analysis and census
sets.basis: The Zenodo removal analysed as loud exclusion (the Pristine Fallacy) and the Platform Erosion Observatory built on the Zenodo Removal Census as its first instrument belong to one programme of response to the removal.

evidence.phrase: The hypothesis is weakened if Zenodo provides record-level evidence
at least one non-Zenodo platform under active preservation
makes "platform erosion" a systemic category rather than a per-platform complaint

sets.basis: One thesis in two wordings: Catullus 51 is not imitation but the arrival of the future reader Sappho 31 anticipated, completing the poem (#134 lines 135-145 says 'Catullus becomes the reader Sappho anticipated'); #134 adds the otium stanza as its ground.

evidence.phrase: Catullus 51 is not imitation but instantiation: Catullus IS κῆνος, the future reader the poem anticipated.
Catullus is not secondary or derivative. He is completing the poem.

sets.name: Sappho 31's open positions taken by receivers
sets.basis: Extends the existing series: κῆνος read as a seat for the future reader, each filling of the poem cutting a fresh hollow in the completer, and Longinus's stamp executing the form in his own Greek all treat fr. 31 as open positions occupied by later receivers (#1476 line 224 opens its series of fillings with 'κῆνος — a seat with no occupant').

evidence.phrase: a seat, not a person: on the reading argued in the fragment's recent philology, the future reader
the act of completing it reproduces its incompleteness in the completer
**The stamp preserves the form in new material, not the surface.**

evidence.phrase: call it compositional bystanding: top organic rank, zero composition eligibility
exact-query success can be mistaken for installation
